bagPolicy.summary: All bags are subject to search, and backpacks of any size are prohibited. Bags over 22″ by 14″ by 9″ are not allowed, with see-through/transparent bags recommended.
prohibited: Cans, bottles, glass or any other beverage containers
Chains, studded bracelets or oversized studded rings
bagPolicy.note: Prescription drugs must be in the original labeled container with conforming government ID (respiratory inhalers excepted).

parking.note: Meyer's Parking Garage is conveniently located next door to the venue at 323-331 W 34th St., New York, NY 10001. No specific pricing information is provided.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Manhattan Center Hammerstein Ballroom's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and drink options are not detailed on the venue's FAQ page. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Manhattan Center is conveniently located one block away from Penn Station and is easily accessible by taking the 1, 2, 3, A, C, or E trains to 34th Street/Penn Station. ADA restrooms are located on the 1st balcony.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Manhattan Center Hammerstein Ballroom's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Located on the far west side of the main lobby, will call opens at door time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors open one hour before the scheduled show time (e.g., if the show is at 8 pm, doors open at 7 pm).
